The disperse (Nb)5Si3 particles strengthened the alloy.
The disperse (Nb)5Si3 particles strengthened the alloy. Coarser microstructure led to the decrease of strength at 1250 ℃, which could be proved by the lowest strength of arc-melting ingot.
the VIM ingot 3 had the highest fracture toughness which could reach an average of 9.05 MPa·m1/2, while the toughness of arc-melting ingot was the lowest.
The ingot 2 and 3 had the similar higher strength of around 300 MPa while the arc-melting ingot had the lowest strength of 264MPa.
